ideas.title: Minnesota Medicaid Fraud: A Deeper Dive
ideas.description: Investigate the $20 billion spent on Medicaid programs in Minnesota and the potential for fraud. Look into the law changes proposed to prevent fraud and the impact on healthcare providers.
questions: What are the specific law changes proposed?
How will these changes impact healthcare providers?
searches: Medicaid programs at high risk for fraud
ideas.insight: The large amount spent on Medicaid programs in Minnesota raises concerns about potential fraud. A deeper dive into the issue could uncover more about the extent of the problem and potential solutions.

ideas.title: HVAC Unit Fires: A Growing Concern
ideas.description: Investigate the HVAC unit fires in schools across the U.S. and the federal investigation into the cause of the fires.
questions: What is the cause of the HVAC unit fires?
How can future incidents be prevented?
ideas.insight: The investigation into HVAC unit fires in schools could uncover more about the cause of the fires and how to prevent future incidents.
